name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Use the latest Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet for EXCAVA’s core reasoning layer. It’s the strongest open model today, beating older versions by ~0.7% on complex tasks—enough to clear the 0.5% threshold. The trade-off is higher API costs, but we offset it by running only the critical inference path through Sonnet while keeping cheaper models for simpler steps.

name: Torque
text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s 0.7% gain is real but fragile—it’s benchmarked on narrow tasks, not EXCAVA’s messy, real-world inputs. The real risk isn’t cost; it’s that the model’s verbosity will bloat EXCAVA’s latency past the point where 0.5% gain becomes irrelevant. Test it live on a 1% traffic slice for 24 hours—if p95 latency rises more than 1%, we scrap it.
